Apple___Apple_scab.cause: Fungal infection caused by Venturia inaequalis.
Apple___Apple_scab.treatment: Apply fungicide and remove infected leaves.
Apple___Apple_scab.prevention: Maintain proper pruning and air circulation.

Apple___Black_rot.treatment: Remove infected fruits and apply fungicides.
Apple___Black_rot.prevention: Keep orchard clean and prune infected branches.

Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.treatment: Use fungicides and prune infected leaves.
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.prevention: Avoid nearby cedar trees and maintain hygiene.

Apple___healthy.cause: Healthy leaf with no visible disease.

Tomato___Early_blight.treatment: Apply fungicide and remove infected leaves.
Tomato___Early_blight.prevention: Rotate crops and avoid overhead watering.

Tomato___Late_blight.prevention: Ensure proper drainage and reduce humidity.

Tomato___healthy.prevention: Continue proper watering and nutrient care.
